messages:
amanda: Quick spot-check found 3 dead links in /docs/optimize and a bad anchor on 'cache strategies' — landing page 404 for quantization.md when accessed via sidebar. Anyone own that section?
kevin: :eyes: which links? can you paste the URLs? I can take the quantization page.
amanda: Sure — 1) https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/quantization (404) 2) https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/cache#cache-strategies (redirects to top of page) 3) internal s3 link in model-onboarding guides -> points to removed bucket. Also the quick fix is to add frontmatter redirect or update link.
marta: tagging — I maintain the optimize section. I'm swamped today but can approve a tiny PR. @kevin please assign to me.
kevin: I'll open PR in a sec. Proposed change: add frontmatter redirect and fix anchor link. Here's suggested frontmatter snippet:
```yaml
redirect_from:
 - /optimize/quantization
```
and change the cache link to /optimize/cache#strategies (the anchor id changed).
oliver: Also flagging: the sidebar entry still points to /optimize/quantization/ (with trailing slash) which might cause the 404. Quick grep shows sidebar TOC at docs/_data/sidebar.yml line ~142.
amanda: Great — kevin can you also update sidebar? If PR today I can merge after marta approves. small tests: run docsite locally: `make docs-dev` and check /optimize/quantization.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428 — includes frontmatter redirect + anchor fix + sidebar update. cc @marta @amanda
docs-bot: deploy preview ready at https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr-1428 — visual check please.
marta: Reviewed, left tiny nit on anchor text. Approving now. :thumbsup: 
amanda: merging after CI passes. thanks everyone!
kevin: CI passed; merged. closing issue. :tada:
